title: kblog.py propose runs over the committed ops sidecars, so _logs.csv holds rows for the operator to confirm
goal: kblog.py propose has been run over every ops row of the committed sidecar (the operator's answer: every event, not a window), so kb/_self/_logs.csv holds proposed rows for the operator to confirm one by one, never confirmed by an agent; a second run on the same store proposes nothing new. A dry run since 2026-09-01 counted about 6600 rows (mostly land.end and land.step of the retired fleet's runs), so the run reports its counts per event and the operator confirms in batches.

gates.question: Which window and events should the first kblog.py propose run over the committed ops sidecars cover?
options: sprint.close and agent.run rows since 2026-10-04 (after the fleet)
every event of the last 7 days
gates.recommendation: sprint.close and agent.run rows since 2026-10-04 (after the fleet)
gates.answer: every ops row of the committed sidecar
